name: synthetic-error-leaderboard
description: An affiliate program on a team with no payment method on file. An ACCOUNT STATE, not a bad request. Vendor non-2xx is DATA: the engine classifies it as a provider error, forces zero usage, and passes the envelope through — `code` is the stable half a caller branches on. Authored from the GrowSurf REST v2 (2.0.0) response shape, verified field for field against a live deployment on 2026-09-22; the identities are GrowSurf's own published example values.

body.name: PaymentMethodRequiredError
body.message: You must add a payment method to your account to use the REST API for affiliate programs.
